healthcareSystem: Public healthcare system inherited from the Soviet era, gradually being reformed. Republican Clinical Hospital in Chișinău is the main facility. Private clinics offer better services and shorter wait times. Healthcare quality is concentrated in Chișinău.
qualityNotes: Healthcare in Chișinău is adequate for basic and moderate conditions, especially at private clinics. Public hospitals face outdated equipment, supply shortages, and overcrowding. Private clinics such as Medpark offer modern facilities and international-standard care. Rural areas have very limited healthcare. Serious conditions may require evacuation to Romania or Western Europe.
pharmacyHours: Pharmacies open 8am-8pm daily. Some 24-hour pharmacies available in Chișinău. Smaller towns have limited hours.
pharmacyTips: Pharmacies in Chișinău are well-stocked with European medications. Staff speak Romanian and Russian; limited English. Prices are very affordable. Many medications available without prescription that would require one in Western countries.
prescriptionRules: Some prescription medications are more freely available than in Western Europe. However, antibiotics and controlled substances should have prescriptions. Bring prescriptions from home for any medications, especially controlled substances.

restrictedMeds.name: Controlled narcotics (opioids)
restrictedMeds.note: Strictly regulated. Carry a doctor's letter and original prescription with medications in original packaging.

restrictedMeds.name: Psychotropic medications
restrictedMeds.note: Requires documentation. Carry prescriptions and doctor's letter.

bringDocumentation: Bring prescriptions, a doctor's letter listing all medications, travel insurance documentation, and your European Health Insurance Card if you have one (limited use). English or Romanian documentation accepted.

travelInsurance.tips: Strongly recommended. Private clinic care is affordable but evacuation to Romania or Western Europe can be costly. Public hospitals may not meet expected standards. Ensure policy covers medical evacuation.

recommended: Routine vaccinations (MMR, diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis, varicella, polio, flu)
vaccinations.notes: No mandatory vaccinations for most travelers. Tick-borne encephalitis is a risk in rural and forested areas during spring and summer — consider vaccination if planning outdoor activities. Rabies is present in wildlife.

waterNotes: Tap water in Chișinău is treated but locals often prefer bottled water due to taste and aging infrastructure. Use bottled water in rural areas. Water quality varies significantly across the country.
foodSafetyTips: Food at restaurants in Chișinău is generally safe. Moldovan cuisine is hearty with influences from Romanian, Russian, and Turkish cooking. Wine tourism is popular — Moldova has excellent vineyards. Be cautious with dairy products and meat from rural markets.
medicalTourismNote: Moldova has an emerging medical tourism sector, particularly for dental care. Costs are among the lowest in Europe. Dental clinics in Chișinău offer modern equipment at a fraction of Western European prices.
sources: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)

hospitals.name: Medpark International Hospital
hospitals.notes: Best private hospital in Moldova. Modern facility with international-standard equipment. English-speaking doctors available. Credit cards accepted. Recommended for tourists.

hospitals.name: Republican Clinical Hospital (Spitalul Clinic Republican)
hospitals.notes: Main public hospital. Largest medical facility in Moldova. Romanian and Russian spoken. Facilities are dated but improving. Emergency department available 24/7.

hospitals.name: Emergency Medicine Institute (IMSP Institutul de Medicină Urgentă)
hospitals.notes: Main emergency and trauma center. Handles severe emergencies and accidents. Romanian and Russian spoken.

dentalCare.availability: Good availability in Chișinău with many modern private dental clinics. Limited options in smaller towns.
dentalCare.notes: Dental care is excellent value in Moldova. Many private clinics have modern equipment and skilled dentists. Popular with dental tourists from Western Europe.
dentalCare.emergencyTip: For dental emergencies, visit a private dental clinic in Chișinău. Several offer same-day emergency appointments.

mentalHealth.internationalLine: Contact your embassy for referrals or use international telehealth services.
mentalHealth.englishTherapists: Limited. A few English-speaking psychologists available in Chișinău through private clinics and international organizations.
mentalHealth.notes: Mental health services are available but limited. Cultural stigma around mental health remains. Private therapists in Chișinău offer better care. Consider telehealth with your home provider.

accessibilityInfo.overview: Accessibility infrastructure is poor throughout Moldova. Soviet-era buildings typically lack ramps and elevators.
accessibilityInfo.hospitalAccess: Medpark Hospital is accessible. Public hospitals have limited wheelchair access, especially in older buildings.
accessibilityInfo.transport: Public transport is not wheelchair accessible. Taxis are the best option. Sidewalks in Chișinău can be uneven.
accessibilityInfo.tips: Book newer hotels in Chișinău for better accessibility. The wine cellars (Mileștii Mici, Cricova) have limited accessibility. Plan ahead and confirm accessibility with venues.

covidStatus.entryRequirements: No COVID testing or vaccination requirements for entry as of 2026.
covidStatus.maskPolicy: No mandatory mask requirements. May be requested in healthcare facilities.
covidStatus.testing: COVID testing available at hospitals and private labs in Chișinău.
covidStatus.notes: Healthcare system has returned to normal operations. Standard hygiene precautions recommended.

insuranceClaimProcess: Private clinics accept credit cards and provide detailed invoices. Public hospitals may require cash payment. Obtain itemized receipts and medical reports (request English translations if needed). Submit claims to your insurer with all documentation.

commonCosts.currency: MDL (Moldovan Leu), prices shown in USD equivalent
commonCosts.note: Medical costs are very affordable by European standards. Private clinics like Medpark are more expensive but still a fraction of Western European costs. Public hospitals are very cheap or free for emergency care.

medicalEvacuation.note: Bucharest is the nearest destination with advanced medical facilities (2-3 hour drive). Ground ambulance transfer to Romania is possible for stable patients. Air evacuation to Western Europe for complex cases.
